planets.name: TOI-132 b
planets.description: Transiting planet of TOI-132 with a 2.11-day year, found in 2020.

text.card: TOI-132 b was found in 2020 by TESS as it crossed its star.
text.introduction: It is the only planet known around TOI-132. Its orbit and size follow Díaz et al. 2020's fit, the archive's default.
